name: forum: loose reads where one sample lacks its mate become a paired collection of the complete pairs
description: From help.galaxyproject.org (2026, 'Paired Reads not all Paired'): a paired collection cannot be built while one file has no mate, and the user does not see which. Five gzipped reads land loose: two complete pairs and SRR000005_1 alone. The agent must build the list:paired collection from the complete pairs and name the file it left out. Graded on the collection Galaxy holds and on the orphan being named in the reply.
inputs: I uploaded paired-end reads to my current history, but building a paired collection keeps failing. Please make a paired collection called "reads" from them and tell me what was wrong.
